name: Fenton Community Foodbank
description: Local foodbank serving Fenton and surrounding areas. Based at Victoria Centre. Open Tue and Fri 10am-2pm. Emergency food parcels available with referral.

name: Stoke-on-Trent City Council Allotments
short_description: Stoke-on-Trent allotment sites in Fenton area
description: Multiple sites including Fenton Park allotments. Plots from £30/year. Includes tool storage and water access.

name: Fenton Community Garden
description: Local volunteer-run garden growing fresh produce. Harvest shared among volunteers and surplus distributed to families in need.
